name: Exp_ColorZerolagRSIOSMA
summary: This EA trades based on the ColorZerolagRSIOSMA custom indicator, a zero-lag composite RSI smoothed with SMA. It opens buy positions when the indicator turns upward and sell positions when it turns downward, with configurable position sizing and stop loss/take profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义指标ColorZerolagRSIOSMA进行交易，该指标是零滞后复合RSI经SMA平滑处理后的结果。当指标向上转折时开多仓，向下转折时开空仓，支持可配置的仓位管理和止损止盈设置。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于零滞后RSI复合指标，通过5个不同周期的RSI（8/21/34/55/89）以加权因子（0.05/0.10/0.16/0.26/0.43）组合，再经两层SMA平滑（周期15和7），消除传统RSI的滞后性。入场条件为：当指标值从前一周期下降转为上升时开多仓，当从上升转为下降时开空仓，同时分别平掉反向仓位。出场条件依赖于反向信号触发平仓，或通过固定点数的止损（1000点）和止盈（2000点）实现。仓位管理支持5种模式：按自由保证金比例、按余额比例、按净自由保证金比例、按净余额比例和固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险敞口比例，默认0.1手固定手数模式。策略默认在H4周期运行，使用SignalBar=1即前一根K线的信号来避免重绘问题。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on a zero-lag composite RSI indicator that combines five RSIs with different periods (8/21/34/55/89) using weighted factors (0.05/0.10/0.16/0.26/0.43), then applies two layers of SMA smoothing (periods 15 and 7) to eliminate traditional RSI lag. Entry conditions: a buy position opens when the indicator value turns from declining to rising, and a sell position opens when it turns from rising to declining, with opposite positions closed simultaneously. Exit conditions rely on reverse signal-triggered closes or fixed stop loss (1000 points) and take profit (2000 points) levels. Position sizing supports five modes: free margin percentage, balance percentage, net free margin percentage, net balance percentage, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled via the MM parameter governing risk exposure, defaulting to 0.1 lot in fixed lot mode. The strategy defaults to H4 timeframe and uses SignalBar=1 to reference the previous bar's signal, avoiding repainting issues.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 交易手数或资金管理比例
parameters.description_en: Lot size or money management ratio

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 资金管理模式（自由保证金/余额/净自由保证金/净余额/固定手数）

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 信号引用K线索引（0=当前K线，1=前一根已确认K线）

pros: 零滞后RSI设计通过多周期加权组合有效减少了传统RSI的滞后性，信号更及时
参数化程度高，5个RSI周期和权重因子均可调整，适应不同市场环境
使用SignalBar=1引用已确认K线信号，避免了指标重绘导致的虚假信号
支持5种仓位管理模式，灵活适配不同风险偏好的交易者
双向交易可独立开关控制，便于单独测试多空信号的有效性
pros_en: Zero-lag RSI design effectively reduces traditional RSI lag through multi-period weighted combination, providing more timely signals
Highly parameterized with 5 adjustable RSI periods and weight factors, adaptable to different market conditions
Uses SignalBar=1 to reference confirmed bar signals, avoiding false signals from indicator repainting
Supports 5 position sizing modes, flexibly accommodating traders with different risk preferences
Buy and sell directions can be independently enabled/disabled, facilitating separate testing of long and short signal effectiveness
cons: 5个加权因子之和为1.0但缺乏自适应调整机制，在市场结构变化时权重可能不再最优
没有点差过滤机制，在高点差环境下可能出现不必要的频繁交易
止损1000点和止盈2000点为固定值，未考虑市场波动率（ATR）的动态变化
指标逻辑完全依赖自定义指标ColorZerolagRSIOSMA，增加了部署和调试的复杂性
缺少持仓数量检查和最大持仓限制，可能在震荡市中同时持有多个仓位
cons_en: The 5 weighting factors sum to 1.0 but lack adaptive adjustment, potentially becoming suboptimal when market structure changes
No spread filter mechanism, which may cause unnecessary frequent trading in high-spread environments
Stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points are fixed values without considering dynamic market volatility (ATR)
Indicator logic entirely depends on the custom ColorZerolagRSIOSMA indicator, increasing deployment and debugging complexity
Lacks position count checks and maximum position limits, potentially holding multiple simultaneous positions in choppy markets
improvements: 引入ATR动态止损止盈，根据市场波动率自动调整止损止盈距离，避免固定点数在不同波动环境下不适配
增加点差过滤和时间过滤机制，避免在点差过大或低流动性时段产生不利成交
添加持仓数量限制和冷却期机制，防止震荡行情中频繁开平仓造成手续费损耗
将加权因子改为自适应计算，根据各周期RSI的近期表现动态调整权重分配
improvements_en: Introduce ATR-based dynamic stop loss and take profit to automatically adjust distances based on market volatility, avoiding fixed point values that may be inappropriate across different volatility regimes
Add spread filter and time filter mechanisms to avoid unfavorable fills during high-spread or low-liquidity periods
Add position count limits and cooldown mechanisms to prevent excessive opening/closing in choppy markets that erode profits through commission costs
Make weighting factors adaptive by dynamically adjusting weight distribution based on recent performance of each RSI period

risk_points: 固定止损止盈未考虑市场波动率变化，在低波动期止损可能过大而在高波动期止盈可能过小
没有最大持仓数量限制和冷却期，趋势反转震荡期可能连续亏损
依赖外部自定义指标文件，若指标缺失或版本不匹配将导致初始化失败
risk_points_en: Fixed stop loss/take profit doesn't account for market volatility changes - SL may be too wide in low-volatility and TP too narrow in high-volatility periods
No maximum position count limit or cooldown period, potentially leading to consecutive losses during trend reversals with choppiness
Depends on external custom indicator file - missing or version-mismatched indicator causes initialization failure
